items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Killian was nice, very nice trumpet player.

ctx.x: I remember in the high note ending of one of the dances in the "Liberian Suite," when Killian would play those high notes, and Kay Davis would be standing in the wings singing the high notes right along with Killian's trumpet.
Uh-huh, yes. Killian was nice, very nice trumpet player. But we'd say that Cat was like a bull. He was very strong.
And Al was killed here in 1950, (inaudible).
